item.title: Jasmine Crockett Hits Campaign Trail To Axe For Votes
item.description: HOUSTON, TX — Representative Jasmine Crockett has officially launched her Senate bid, immediately hitting the campaign trail to "axe for votes."

item.title: Report: Backs Of Cereal Boxes Have Really Gone Downhill
item.description: U.S. — A recent report finds that the backs of cereal boxes have really gone downhill over the years, which is lame.

item.title: Michigan Taps Marco Rubio As Interim Head Coach
item.description: ANN ARBOR, MI — Just moments after news broke that the University of Michigan had fired head football coach Sherrone Moore with cause, Secretary of State Marco Rubio had been tapped as interim coach.

item.title: Meaning Of Christmas Revealed To Actually Be Those Popcorn Tins With The Three Types Of Popcorn
item.description: The meaning of Christmas has been officially revealed, and it's all about those metal tins with three types of popcorn. Yep. Would you have guessed it?

item.title: Whoaa This B-List Actor Just Said Something Remotely Christian Whoaaaa
US Military Persuades Entire Venezuelan Army To Surrender By Offering Them Some Food
item.description: VENEZUELA — In a remarkable demonstration of martial superiority, the United States military just forced an unconditional surrender out of the entire Venezuelan army just by offering them some food.

item.title: Thinking About Going To Church? Here Are 10 Tips For Your First Sunday
item.description: Attending a church for the first time can be a daunting experience. If this is the first time you're attending church this Sunday, try not to stress too much about what it'll be like to be in an entirely new place surrounded by people you don't know. Just follow these handy tips, and you'll be just fine.
